ConnectionProbe.title: ConnectionProbe
ConnectionProbe.description: Read-only connectivity probe document used by getDocFromServer on application boot.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the actor performing the write.

UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Non-PII user profile metadata stored under /users/{userId}/public/profile.

accountTier.description: Non-privileged account tier; institutional roles are governed via /schools/{schoolId}/members.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the user updating this profile.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Strictly isolated PII record stored under /users/{userId}/private/info.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the actor updating this document.

SchoolInstitution.title: SchoolInstitution
SchoolInstitution.description: Master Gate root institutional profile for schools, colleges, and professional institutes.

crest.description: Institution crest URL or bounded image data URL.

whatsappNumber.description: Direct WhatsApp phone number configured by the school or institute owner.

whatsappEnabled.description: Whether direct visitor WhatsApp messaging is enabled for this school or institute.

enabledModules.description: Bounded list (max 25) of enabled module IDs.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the institution creator/owner.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the last authorised updater.

isPublic.description: Whether the institution appears in the public institution switcher.

SchoolMember.title: SchoolMember
SchoolMember.description: Role-based institutional membership document under /schools/{schoolId}/members/{memberUid}. Contains zero personal contact PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member.

schoolOwnerUid.description: UID of the parent school owner for cost-safe list queries.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the actor writing this record.

AuthorizedSignatoryDoc.title: AuthorizedSignatoryDoc
AuthorizedSignatoryDoc.description: Drawn or uploaded digital signature record for teachers, registrars, and heads of institution.

signatureDataUrl.description: Bounded PNG/SVG data URL of drawn or uploaded signature.

active.description: Whether signatory is active for certificate issuance.

ProfessionalProgrammeDoc.title: ProfessionalProgrammeDoc
ProfessionalProgrammeDoc.description: Multi-level academic or professional certification programme definition.

enum: Dual: Institution Award + Professional Body Designation

levels.description: Bounded array (1 to 6) of level configuration maps.

isPublished.description: Whether visible in student course catalog.

ProgrammeCourseDoc.title: ProgrammeCourseDoc
ProgrammeCourseDoc.description: Course curriculum unit belonging to a ProfessionalProgrammeDoc.

levelLabel.description: Display level label (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3, or Certificate).

courseDetails.description: Detailed syllabus overview and scope of the course.

rationale.description: Academic and professional rationale for offering the course.

objectives.description: Bounded array (0 to 20) of course learning objective strings.

flyerDataUrl.description: Optional promotional course flyer image Data URL or HTTPS image URL.

StudentRecordDoc.title: StudentRecordDoc
StudentRecordDoc.description: Enrolled student record containing guardian PII, strictly isolated to school staff and matching verified student/guardian email.

studentEmail.description: Student portal email for verified self-service read access.

CandidateProfileDoc.title: CandidateProfileDoc
CandidateProfileDoc.description: Professional certification candidate profile with PII isolated to staff and the verified candidate.

email.description: Candidate email for verified portal login.

identityVerified.description: Whether candidate identity has been verified.

completedLevels.description: Bounded list (max 6) of completed level numbers.

enum: Associate Member (Awarded by External Professional Body)

directoryConsent.description: Candidate consent for public graduate directory.

CandidateAssessmentDoc.title: CandidateAssessmentDoc
CandidateAssessmentDoc.description: Candidate examination, CA, practical, moderation, exemption, and resit assessment record.

candidateEmail.description: Candidate email for verified self-service read.

studentEmail.description: Student email for verified portal read access.

FeePaymentDoc.title: FeePaymentDoc
FeePaymentDoc.description: Student/candidate tuition or examination fee receipt with PII isolated.

studentEmail.description: Student/candidate email for verified receipt viewing.

status.description: Payment settlement status (Completed is terminal for non-admins).

IssuedCredentialDoc.title: IssuedCredentialDoc
IssuedCredentialDoc.description: Authoritative digital certificate record synced atomically with /publicCredentials/{publicLookupKey}.

status.description: Credential validity status (Revoked and Replaced are terminal states).

professionalBodyAffiliationNote.description: Affiliation note distinguishing institutional award vs professional body designation.

auditTrail.description: Bounded array (max 25) of immutable audit trail entries.

PublicCredentialVerificationDoc.title: PublicCredentialVerificationDoc
PublicCredentialVerificationDoc.description: Privacy-filtered public QR & employer verification projection containing zero marks, financial balances, or private contact details.

isPublic.description: Always true so public QR verifiers can query/verify.

GraduateRecordDoc.title: GraduateRecordDoc
GraduateRecordDoc.description: Permanent institutional alumni record containing graduate contact PII isolated to staff and the graduate.

directoryConsent.description: Graduate opt-in consent for public employer search.

PublicGraduateDirectoryDoc.title: PublicGraduateDirectoryDoc
PublicGraduateDirectoryDoc.description: Consent-based public graduate directory entry containing zero personal contact PII.

certificateStatus.description: Only Valid certificates appear in the public directory.

ReplacementRequestDoc.title: ReplacementRequestDoc
ReplacementRequestDoc.description: Graduate or student request for a replacement certificate.

status.description: Review status (Approved & Re-issued and Declined are terminal states).

VerificationLogDoc.title: VerificationLogDoc
VerificationLogDoc.description: Immutable append-only audit log of authenticated credential verification requests.

ResearchArticleDoc.title: ResearchArticleDoc
ResearchArticleDoc.description: Open-access scholarly journal article containing zero personal contact PII.

authors.description: Bounded array (1 to 10) of non-PII author maps (name, role, affiliation).

keywords.description: Bounded array (1 to 12) of keyword strings.

sections.description: Bounded array (1 to 15) of article section maps.

references.description: Bounded array (0 to 30) of bibliographic citation strings.

/test/{docId}.description: Boot connectivity check target for getDocFromServer.

/schools/{schoolId}.description: Master Gate root institutional profile documents.

/schools/{schoolId}/signatories/{signato.description: Authorized digital signatories for institutional certificates.

/schools/{schoolId}/assessments/{assessm.description: Candidate course marks, moderation, exemptions, and resits.

/schools/{schoolId}/examResults/{resultI.description: Term examination and continuous assessment results.

/schools/{schoolId}/feePayments/{payment.description: PII-isolated tuition and examination fee payment receipts.

/schools/{schoolId}/credentials/{credent.description: Institutional issued certificates and audit trails.

/publicCredentials/{certificateKey}.description: Privacy-safe public QR & employer verification projection.

/publicArticles/{articleId}.description: Open-access institutional scholarly press and journals.
